sampling.unit: continuous world, not independently invented frames
sampling.interpretation: balanced mechanism coverage; not estimated biological frequencies
sampling.parameter_prior: one common observation prior across all cores and subjects

observation_prior.rationale: Weaker HGA gain and reduced explicit coupling follow v9/v10 diagnostics. Spatial/drive intervals are bounded engineering diversity, not identified neural parameters. Extra global gain remains excluded.
excluded: clinical artifacts without an explicit validated prior

frontend.normalizer: per-contact/bin lower median and 1.4826 lower MAD; floor 1e-6
frontend.g3: clip normalized content to [-15,15]; complete synthetic availability

session.statistical_scope: offline world; generator field standardization uses the simulated trajectory. This is not a causal online simulator.

provenance.group_id: namespace/core/core_seed; group every geometry, renderer and crop sharing a rule
provenance.separation: no world group may cross train/validation; reserve namespaces before generating
provenance.core_rule: generator functions sample parameters and initial conditions together; retain arrays plus full source hashes, not seed alone
provenance.anatomy: unknown; no fabricated atlas labels. Training integration is a separate contract.
